title: Air conditioner control experiment (10 subjects, 4 classes, 25 EEG ch)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 10 healthy subjects performing a P300-based brain-computer interface task for home appliance control. The experiment employed a visual oddball paradigm with 25-channel EEG acquisition at 500 Hz, featuring target and non-target stimulus classifications. Data were collected in a laboratory setting with online visual feedback, yielding 50 training and 30 testing trials per subject.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 25-channel actiCHamp system (Brain Products) at 500 Hz sampling rate with linked mastoid reference and standard 10-20 electrode montage. Subjects performed a P300 oddball task with visual flash stimuli presented on an LCD display at 750 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. The paradigm involved target and non-target classifications with online visual feedback in a laboratory environment.
